integrationPoints.contract: POST /api/v1/auth/login with username/password and CAPTCHA response, returns session cookie
GET /api/v1/grades with session cookie, returns grade data with filters
GET /api/v1/attendance with session cookie, returns attendance data
GET /api/v1/events with session cookie, returns vulcan events
GET /api/v1/subjects with session cookie, returns subjects
Supabase table with RLS for session persistence, expires_at indexing
